title: CGX Physical Node Snapshot / DBR / Handshake Contract
purpose: Make a physical UTP or printed solid-state object a programmable, interconnectable .cgx node whose declared capability can be reproduced, compared, repaired and transferred without embedding the whole Cognigrex corpus locally.
identity_rule: stable node identity persists across software/model updates; capability and evidence state are versioned snapshots, not identity replacements

layers.C0: deterministic safety/motion/process control remains local and independently bounded
layers.C2: Cognigrex/LightSpeed/Raphael federation provides heavy planning, portfolio routing and cross-node reconciliation when connected

dbr_record.rule: DBR records provenance/state transitions; it does not by itself certify physical performance.

handshake.payload: identity, revisions, authority roots, network/security class
local materials, energy, ecology, governance, gravity/environment, latency and human support
calibration, maintenance, power, feeds, tools, safety and current jobs
compiled DAG, hashes, expected resource use, acceptance/falsification tests
deterministic execution trace + raw evidence locators
measured function, uncertainty, residuals and pass/repair/reject state
immutable transition receipt and twin update
bounded state transfer with receiving acknowledgement

object_identity.rule: printed technology may itself become a .cgx node when persistent state/control/maintenance benefit justifies it; passive parts may instead inherit a parent object's material/process passport

compute_boundary: Functional equivalence is a graph-of-functions requirement. A phone-equivalent CGX object can distribute display/storage/sensing/comms/control across printed geometry plus modest edge compute/network services; it need not reproduce smartphone SoC density unless that density is itself a requirement.
safety: Semantic/AI layers may compile and reason; hard interlocks and hazardous process limits remain deterministic/local.
